description: VI snippet PNGs (each carrying a LabVIEW VI in its niVI chunk) collected from public web pages, byte-identical to the published images. Only sources with an explicit license or an explicit reuse grant are included; the basis is recorded per source and the page and image URL per file, with the uploader where the license requires attribution.

ni-kb.name: NI Knowledge Base
ni-kb.basis: NI-authored support articles whose snippet figures carry NI's note that the image "includes LabVIEW code that you can reuse in your project" and invite readers to save it and drag it onto their diagram (in the article's own language). © National Instruments Corporation; ni.com Terms of Use apply.

labviewwiki.name: LabVIEW Wiki
labviewwiki.basis: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (site rights info: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/); uploader and page recorded per entry.

hampel-soft.name: Hampel Software Engineering knowledge base
hampel-soft.basis: Wiki footer: "Except where otherwise noted, content on this wiki is licensed under the following license: CC Attribution-Share Alike 4.0 International."

erdos-miller.name: Erdos Miller blog
erdos-miller.basis: The blog's images are published in the MIT-licensed repository https://github.com/erdosmiller/blog.

frc-docs.name: FIRST Robotics Competition documentation (WPI)
frc-docs.basis: Site footer: licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License; sources at https://github.com/wpilibsuite/frc-docs.

wikimedia-commons.name: Wikimedia Commons
wikimedia-commons.basis: File page: Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 4.0, uploader's own work.

stackoverflow.name: Stack Overflow
stackoverflow.basis: User contributions are licensed CC BY-SA (2.5, 3.0 or 4.0 by contribution date; the version is recorded per file from the Stack Exchange API together with the author and the post link, which the attribution requirements ask for).

developpez.name: Developpez.net LabVIEW forum and blogs
developpez.basis: Every forum page carries the site notice: "Les sources présentées sur cette page sont libres de droits et vous pouvez les utiliser à votre convenance" (the sources shown on this page are free of rights and may be used as you wish); the surrounding page text is reserved. Images are the ones embedded in the posts.
